title: 第5章 武祖殿第6章 剑道试炼
content_zh:
紫月殿外。
“主子，夏紫萱这女人太不识抬举，要不要老奴暗中教训她一下。”
吴有山阴惻惻的说道，虽然他故意改变了自己的嗓音，听起来没那么尖锐，但依旧改变不了阉人的本质。
马车上，夏瑞明眼眸低垂，冷不丁一巴掌抽在吴有山脸上。
“夏紫萱再不识抬举，她也是我的同父异母的亲姐，你想让我背上不仁不义的骂名？”
“主子息怒，奴才说错话了。”
吴有山满脸惶恐的跪拜下来。
“夏紫萱不能出事，但她的紫月殿里多死几个人，也无伤大雅。”
吴有山连连点头：“奴才明白了。”
“嗯。”
夏瑞明淡淡的瞥了吴有山一眼：“小山子，听说你最近跟夏蓝曦走的挺近。”
吴有山心头一突，忙不迭解释道：“主子误会了，六公主殿下是来找我帮她炼製化气散的，她开价极高，奴才想著多赚一些，就能多为主子分担一些。”
“那你倒是挺有心。”
夏瑞明摩挲著下巴，凝眉沉思起来。
“小六虽然年纪不大，手段倒是颇为不俗，竟给她攀上了升仙门的圣子，若有升仙门在背后扶持，这祖龙祭典怕是又要激烈三分了。”
“最后一年了，此番风云莫测，不知谁能笑到最后。”
吴有山立刻露出一副諂媚笑容：“能夺下帝位的，肯定是主子您。”
“呵……”
……
“今天开始紫月殿加强防备，尤其要注意毒虫蛇蚁的滋扰。”

大厅內，夏紫萱叮嘱了一声。
隨后她又看向楚夏，道：“你隨我去一趟武祖殿。”
“好。”
楚夏没多想就答应下来。
他刚好也想见识一下武祖殿究竟是什么地方。
“殿下，您伤势尚未恢復，现在去武祖殿太危险了。”
“是啊殿下，身体要紧。”
两名容貌清秀的龙渊卫劝说起来。
楚夏这时才注意到，这二人长得一模一样，居然是一对双胞胎姐妹。
而且这二人修为不俗，皆是通玄境的强者。
“没时间磨蹭了，你们两个也跟我一起去。”
夏紫萱雷厉风行，直接出发。
一行人风风火火的登上马车，转眼间就来到了武祖殿外。
下马车的时候，楚夏莫名感到一股威压袭来。
抬头望去，只见一座古老的殿宇横贯天地间。
这殿宇规模很是庞大，看起来十分古老，但並不残破，到处雕樑画栋，望去儘是亭台楼阁，周围被一圈茂密的槐树笼罩。
这些槐树生的异常高大，枝繁叶茂，將武祖殿完全遮蔽，从而显得有些阴气沉沉。
“跟紧我，不要东张西望。”
夏紫萱叮嘱了一声，隨后便径直朝著殿內前进。
两个双胞胎则是一左一右护在夏紫萱两侧，神情紧张严肃。

一路行至正殿，並未发生任何意外，也没看到任何人影。
但楚夏隱约感觉的出来，这地方不简单，里面存在一些很诡异的气息。
正殿內十分空旷，仅耸立著一座墨黑的石碑。
“武祖玄空。”
楚夏看著石碑上的文字，疑惑道：“他是何人？”
content_en:
Outside Ziyue Palace.
"Master, Xia Zixuan is a woman who doesn't know how to praise. Do you want me to teach her a lesson in secret?"
Wu Youshan said sadly. Although he deliberately changed his voice to make it sound less sharp, it still could not change the eunuch's nature.
On the carriage, Xia Ruiming lowered his eyes and slapped Wu Youshan suddenly on the face.
"No matter how disrespectful Xia Zixuan is, she is also my half-sister. Do you want me to be accused of being unkind and unjust?"
"Master, calm down, my slave said the wrong thing."
Wu Youshan knelt down with fear on his face.
"Nothing can happen to Xia Zixuan, but it won't hurt if a few more people die in her Ziyue Palace."
Wu Youshan nodded repeatedly: "I understand."
"Yeah."
Xia Ruiming glanced at Wu Youshan lightly: "Xiao Shanzi, I heard that you have been very close to Xia Lanxi recently."
Wu Youshan had a sudden thought and hurriedly explained: "Master has misunderstood. Her Royal Highness the Sixth Princess came to me to help her refine the Qi Transformation Powder. She offered a very high price. I thought that if I earn more, I can share more with the Master."
"Then you are quite thoughtful."
Xia Ruiming rubbed her chin and frowned in thought.
"Although Xiaoliu is young, her skills are quite impressive. She actually made her the Holy Son of the Immortal Immortal Sect. If the Immortal Immortal Sect is supporting her, this Ancestral Dragon Festival will be fierce again."
"It's the last year, and this situation is unpredictable. I don't know who will have the last laugh."
Wu Youshan immediately showed a flattering smile: "The one who can seize the throne must be you, master."
"Heh..."
…
"Purple Moon Palace will strengthen its defenses starting today, and pay special attention to the nuisance of poisonous insects, snakes and ants."
In the hall, Xia Zixuan warned.
Then she looked at Chu Xia and said, "Follow me to the Martial Ancestor Hall."
"Okay."
Chu Xia agreed without much thought.
He happened to also want to see what the Martial Ancestor Hall was.
"Your Highness, you have not recovered from your injuries. It is too dangerous to go to Wu Zu Palace now."
"Yes, Your Highness, your health is urgent."
Two handsome Long Yuan guards began to persuade.
Only then did Chu Xia notice that the two looked exactly the same and were actually twin sisters.
Moreover, these two people have good cultivation and are both strong men in the Tongxuan Realm.
"We don't have time to waste time. You two should come with me."
Xia Zixuan acted resolutely and set off directly.
The group of people boarded the carriage in a hurry and arrived outside the Wuzu Hall in a blink of an eye.
When getting off the carriage, Chu Xia felt an inexplicable pressure coming over her.
Looking up, I saw an ancient palace stretching across the sky and earth.
This palace is very large in scale and looks very ancient, but it is not dilapidated. There are carved beams and painted buildings everywhere, pavilions and pavilions as far as the eye can see, and it is surrounded by a circle of dense locust trees.
These locust trees are unusually tall, with lush branches and leaves, completely covering the Wuzu Hall, making it look a bit gloomy.
"Follow me closely and don't look around."
Xia Zixuan warned, and then headed straight into the palace.
The two twins were guarding Xia Zixuan, one on the left and the other on the right, with nervous and serious expressions.
Walking all the way to the main hall, no accidents occurred and no one was seen.
But Chu Xia could vaguely feel that this place was not simple, and there were some very strange auras inside.
The main hall is very empty, with only a black stone monument standing there.
"Martial Ancestor Xuankong."
Chu Xia looked at the words on the stone tablet and wondered: "Who is he?"
